pdfcraft-windows-installation.en.title: PdfCraft for Windows: Installer and Portable Setup
pdfcraft-windows-installation.en.description: Choose the right PdfCraft Windows download, compare MSI and portable ZIP builds, verify the file and complete a first-run PDF check.
pdfcraft-windows-installation.en.image_alt: PdfCraft command palette listing tools and commands over an open PDF
pdfcraft-windows-installation.en.image_caption: After setup, search for a tool by name. The project showcase illustrates the interface; window styling varies by operating system.

pdfcraft-linux-installation.en.title: PdfCraft on Linux: Ubuntu, Mint, Flatpak and AppImage
pdfcraft-linux-installation.en.description: Install PdfCraft on Linux with a suitable package, check CPU architecture, run Flatpak or AppImage builds and troubleshoot first-launch issues.
pdfcraft-linux-installation.en.image_alt: PdfCraft project showcase in dark theme with a PDF and comments panel
pdfcraft-linux-installation.en.image_caption: The desktop workflow is shared across platforms; the showcase window and your Linux desktop may look different.

pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.zh.title: PdfCraft 入门教程：完成第一份 PDF 整理工作
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.zh.description: 从打开文件、搜索文字到整理页面、合并附件和检查导出结果，跟着实例学会使用 PdfCraft，并避开常见的新手问题。
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.zh.image_alt: PdfCraft 项目示例：打开 PDF 后的全部工具侧栏和评论面板
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.zh.image_caption: 先用一份较小的 PDF 副本练习，方便将保存后的结果与原件比较。

switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.en.title: PdfCraft vs Adobe Acrobat: A Practical Migration Guide
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.en.description: Compare PdfCraft and Adobe Acrobat using your real documents. Test page tools, forms, text, scans and saved outputs before moving your PDF workflow.
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.en.image_alt: Interactive form fields and field list in the upstream PdfCraft showcase
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.en.image_caption: Forms are a useful migration test: a document that looks correct still needs its field values and behavior checked.

pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.en.title: PdfCraft Tutorial: Your First PDF Workflow
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.en.description: Learn how to use PdfCraft to find text, organize pages, combine documents and check your saved PDF, with a practical first-project walkthrough.
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.en.image_alt: PdfCraft project showcase with a PDF open, the All tools sidebar and threaded comments
pdfcraft-tutorial-beginners.en.image_caption: Start with a copy of a small PDF so you can compare the saved result with the original.

switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.zh.title: PdfCraft 与 Adobe Acrobat 对比：实际工作流迁移指南
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.zh.description: 用自己的 PDF 对比页面整理、表单、扫描件、文字编辑和保存结果，逐项判断哪些 Adobe Acrobat 工作可以迁移到 PdfCraft。
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.zh.image_alt: 上游 PdfCraft 项目示例中的交互表单与字段列表
switch-from-adobe-acrobat-to-pdfcraft.zh.image_caption: 表单是很好的迁移测试样本：外观正确之外，还要检查字段值是否保存、交互是否符合预期。

pdfcraft-windows-installation.zh.title: Windows 安装 PdfCraft：安装包与便携版完整指南
pdfcraft-windows-installation.zh.description: 分清 x64、ARM64 和 x86 下载，选择 MSI 或便携 ZIP，验证文件并完成首次运行检查，解决 Windows 上的常见安装问题。
pdfcraft-windows-installation.zh.image_alt: PdfCraft 命令面板显示可搜索的工具和命令
pdfcraft-windows-installation.zh.image_caption: 安装后可按名称搜索工具。截图来自项目展示，实际窗口外观随操作系统而变化。

pdfcraft-linux-installation.zh.title: Linux 安装 PdfCraft：Ubuntu、Mint、Flatpak 与 AppImage
pdfcraft-linux-installation.zh.description: 按发行版和 CPU 架构选择 PdfCraft 安装方式，了解 deb、Flatpak、AppImage 的具体步骤与首次启动、文件权限和更新排查。
pdfcraft-linux-installation.zh.image_alt: PdfCraft 项目深色主题展示，包含 PDF 页面与评论面板
pdfcraft-linux-installation.zh.image_caption: 各平台共享主要文档工作流，展示图的窗口外观可能与实际 Linux 桌面不同。
